therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD123-specific CAR-T cell therapy with CD28 costimulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: targeted elimination of CD123-expressing BPDCN cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm (BPDCN)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase 1: Safety and Tolerability, MTD; Phase 2: Response Rate

results.dose_information: Single dose up to 600 x 10^6 CAR-T+ cells with fludarabine 30 mg/m2/day IV (3 days) and cyclophosphamide 300-500 mg/m2/day IV (3 days) lymphodepletion
